summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 4: Variant-to-Template Promotion Logic v1. All 20 backend API tests passed (1 skipped due to no style-candidate available). All frontend UI features working correctly including Promotion Queue page, PageWorkspace promotion callout, and navigation.

POST /api/promotions/evaluate - returns 404 for non-existent version
POST /api/promotions/evaluate - returns 404 for non-existent page
GET /api/promotions/candidates - returns all candidates with status_counts
GET /api/promotions/candidates?status=pending - filters by pending status
GET /api/promotions/candidates?status=promoted - filters by promoted status
GET /api/promotions/candidates?status=dismissed - filters by dismissed status
GET /api/promotions/candidates?status=deferred - filters by deferred status
GET /api/promotions/candidates/{id} - returns single candidate with signals and explanations
GET /api/promotions/candidates/{id} - returns 404 for non-existent candidate
GET /api/promotions/page/{page_id} - returns candidates for specific page
GET /api/promotions/page/{page_id} - returns empty list for non-existent page
POST /api/promotions/candidates/{id}/action with action=dismiss - dismisses candidate
POST /api/promotions/candidates/{id}/action with action=decide-later - defers candidate
POST /api/promotions/candidates/{id}/action - returns 400 for invalid action
POST /api/promotions/candidates/{id}/action - returns 404 for non-existent candidate

POST /api/promotions/candidates/{id}/action with action=create-template - creates house template
Signals have human-readable explanations with signal, value, and explanation fields

Navigation sidebar shows Promotions link with TrendingUp icon

Candidate cards display with page name, family, version, score, signal count
Candidate cards show promotion type badges (Exemplar gold, Template green, Style purple)
Candidate expand/collapse working with signals and action buttons

PageWorkspace promotion callout shows action buttons (Exemplar, Template, Style, Later, Dismiss)
PageWorkspace promotion action buttons work and remove callout after action
Template created via promotion action verified in house_templates collection
seed_data_creation: Homepage v1 promotion candidate created during testing. Templates created via promotion action.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Promotion Logic fully functional. Promotion evaluation uses 9 signal types with human-readable explanations. Promotion types: exemplar (gold #FFCC00), template (green #34C759), style-candidate (purple #AF52DE). Thresholds: exemplar_min_score=85, template_min_score=80, style_candidate_min_score=82. Auto-evaluation triggers after scoring when score >= 80. Homepage v1 is already an exemplar, so promote-exemplar returns 409 conflict. create-template action creates house template with extracted structural pattern. save-style-candidate saves tonal signals for later review.
